title: The Capture Registry — Retrieval Reception of the Alexanarch Corpus
description: The archive's reception instrument, and its join to the corpus it measures. EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 records how AI Overview, AI Mode, and comparable summarisation surfaces compose answers about this corpus: what they attribute, what they strip, what they invert, and what they return as definitional. Entries are dated, screenshot-evidenced, and classified by match type. Authored and versioned at machinemediation.org; mirrored here with the link map that binds capture events to the deposits they concern, so that provenance-erasure rate and erasure skew are computable per deposit rather than per capture. This dataset is the instrument the other members are measured with: where the Tombstone Mirror records what the platform did to the corpus, the Capture Registry records what the retrieval layer does with it.

records.name: EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json
records.description: The Capture Registry itself, v9.19 (2026-07-25), 221 capture events. Synchronised copy; the canonical home and author of record is https://www.machinemediation.org/data/registry.json. Each entry carries the query, the surface and authentication state, the composed attribution observed verbatim, a match-type classification, and an analysis.

records.name: capture-deposit-links.json
records.description: Capture ↔ deposit link map: 443 edges joining 148 of 221 captures to the deposit corpus, each edge recording the resolution method so any confidence tier can be discarded. Includes the severance rollup: of captures whose primary deposit carries a DOI record, 65 land on severed works and 6 do not.

records.name: semantic-addresses.json
records.description: Semantic addresses, 2009 canonical queries across observation and subjunctive tributaries. Capture-derived addresses carry refers_to and deposit_links, making retrieval observations joinable to the works observed.
